# https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/php/v1/methods/invalidate

Source: https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/php/v1/methods/invalidate

Invalidates the authentication for the current connection.
Method Syntax

```php
$db->invalidate()
```

###  Example usage[](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/php/v1/methods/invalidate#example-usage)

```php
$db->invalidate();
```
